Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 14

“Beings come into being from food, food is produced from rain, rain arises from sacrifice, and sacrifice is born of action.”

Krishna traces a physical chain from the plate backward to the deed. Each link is ordinary and observable until the last, which quietly folds human action into the weather.
